title: Ghostbusters
platform: ICE/Raw Thrills Linux PC Based (32-bit ELF, unmodified)

options.description_en: Free play: no credits needed to start a game. RavenGun seeds this to ON on the first start (data/adj/playerCost in the write layer; the game's own settings, the NAS is not touched), so Start or the trigger alone starts a game. Takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.

Price of one game in cents (100 = one dollar). With coin value 25 a game costs four coins. Saved in the game's own settings in its local write layer (native route; the NAS is not touched); takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.

Price of one continue in cents (100 = one dollar). Saved in the game's own settings in its local write layer (native route; the NAS is not touched); takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.

Value of coin mechanism 1 in cents (25 = one quarter). Saved in the game's own settings in its local write layer (native route; the NAS is not touched); takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.

Game sound volume (0-100). Saved in the game's own settings in its local write layer (native route; the NAS is not touched); takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.

Attract-mode volume (0-100). Saved in the game's own settings in its local write layer (native route; the NAS is not touched); takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.

Use the cabinet's ball shooter mechanisms. Off silences the "CHECK LEFT/RIGHT BALL SHOOTER" messages on a setup without the hardware (RavenGun ships it off). Saved in the game's own settings in its local write layer (native route; the NAS is not touched); takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.

options.note_en: The five levels follow the game's own audit categories; the TEST menu shows the authoritative list.

items.description_en: Raw Thrills user store (USERDIR in run_game.sh). Not in the dump; created at first run.
items.erase_effect_en: run_game.sh itself deletes it on exit code 240 (audit wipe). Resets scores, audits and adjustments.
